A little escape, close to nature

Welcome to The Mountain Nest

Nestled amidst the serene mountains and lush greenery of 14th Mile, Ravangla, The Mountain Nest Homestay & Maitri Café is a peaceful retreat where comfort meets the beauty of nature. Enjoy breathtaking mountain views and refreshing fresh air in a warm, welcoming atmosphere—perfect for travellers seeking relaxation, adventure and an authentic local experience.
